tissue_constraint_net.seed: The operator asked for the graph layer: variables in quantified relation with edge status, not bookkeeping. This net was assembled 2026-10-03 from the night's own measurements after the graph lane established that this slot was declared and empty.
tissue_constraint_net.objective: Say, per pair of quantities, whether the relation is constrained by a measurement (TIGHT), measured to be insufficient or undetermined with the gap as the number (OPEN), or asserted in a model with nothing bearing on it (UNKNOWN).
tissue_constraint_net.schema_note: Same shape as vehicle_constraints and projector_constraints: variables with unit and level, edges with between, constraint, status and evidence. Additive — nothing was moved and no other net was touched.

measuring it instead of estimating it cuts residual cylinder error from 0.6264 to 0.2817 D against measured refraction on 69 patients, and this is now confirmed by THREE independent sources for the same input: 0.2817 (IOLMaster posterior), 0.2934 (CASIA posterior, conventions aligned) and 0.3112 D (CASIA total cornea measured in one step). The two devices print ORTHOGONAL posterior meridians, 86 degrees apart in median, and taking the printed axis gives 0.7577 D, which nearly produced a false refutation of this edge

edges.constraint: the chain converts 1 mm of lens position into 1.349 D of refraction (median over 89 eyes); the position is predictable from preoperative biometry to 0.114 mm mean absolute error against the quantity own spread of 0.284 mm, so the induced refraction error is 0.114 D median

the largest single term in the refraction calculation and we hold it from ONE instrument only; no second source exists in our data, so its between-device bias is unmeasured. For comparison the two devices we can compare disagree systematically by 9.90 um on corneal thickness and 0.1441 mm on anterior chamber depth, so a bias of that order here is not excluded

we treat the printed label as exact. The decision is quantised to a 0.5 D manufacturing grid, and our choice lands on a different step than the lens that was implanted in 44 of 89 eyes, so if the tolerance on the label approaches a grid step it places a floor under every power decision that no model can go below
